Class RealizedGainCalculator

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.RealizedGainCalculator
public class RealizedGainCalculator extends Object
Turns the transactions of a tenant into the realized gains per year. It calls the transaction calculation once for every security, so the gain of a sale is the one every other view of the same cost basis method shows, and it only selects, converts and groups the sales that calculation produced. It holds no state between calls and loads nothing.

The security account filter is applied after the calculation. With FIFO and LIFO every security account keeps its own ledger, so filtering earlier would not matter. With average cost all security accounts of a security share one pool, and filtering earlier would change the gain of a sale.

      public RealizedGainGrandTotal calculate(Map<Security, List<Transaction>> transactionsBySecurity, Map<Integer, List<Securitysplit>> securitySplitMap, LocalDate untilDate, DateTransactionCurrencypairMap dateCurrencyMap, CostBasisMethods costBasisMethods, boolean excludeDivTax, Set<Integer> idsSecurityaccount)
      Calculates the realized gains of all given securities.
      Parameters:
      transactionsBySecurity - the transactions of every security of the tenant, each list with all of its security accounts
      securitySplitMap - the splits by security id
      untilDate - the last day whose transactions count, normally today
      dateCurrencyMap - the exchange rates to the main currency
      costBasisMethods - the methods the calculation applies
      excludeDivTax - the tenant setting of the tax on dividends, passed on to the calculation
      idsSecurityaccount - the security accounts whose sales are reported, null for all
      Returns:
      the years, the newest first
